name: LA Fashion Source
old_description: Troubles with cut and sew production? Our experts will do it for you!
about:
LA Fashion Source operates from Los Angeles, California. The company was founded by Shalcy Robins, who brings 16 years of experience across wholesale, vertical retail, and corporate operations in the fashion industry. Robins established the business to help apparel companies manage manufacturing and sourcing more efficiently.

The firm provides end-to-end apparel services spanning design, development, and production. Its design phase covers tech packs, pattern cards, pattern making, sample making, and specialty cuts. In production, it handles grading, cut-and-sew manufacturing, screen printing, sublimation, embroidery, and garment finishing such as trimming, pressing, folding, labeling, bagging, and packaging. LA Fashion Source also sources fabrics, trims, and hardware, leveraging domestic and international vendor relationships, including factories in Mexico and China for high-volume cut-and-sew orders.

Clients include fashion brands and apparel companies producing categories such as athleisure, women’s dresses, denim, and other soft goods. The company serves both business-to-business and business-to-consumer operations, offering support from product costing and logistics to quality assurance and import management.

Robins created LA Fashion Source to remove the operational headaches of manufacturing and sourcing, promising a single point of contact that can handle any project scale while maintaining quality and cost targets.
